core.title: Arched Mansion Double Cylinder Handleset, Weslock 6651/6602

text.description_html:
Weslock 6651/6602, Double Cylinder Arched Mansion Handleset

Available in satin nickel or oil rubbed bronze finishes, the Weslock Mansion Double Cylinder Handleset features graceful arched plates. No matter which of the finishes you choose, the Mansion handleset will add a touch of simple richness to your doors. The beveled edges paired with the curved handle are a picture of elegance and subtle beauty. Easy to install, the Mansion Entryset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A double cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from both the exterior and the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. Double cylinder entry sets are most often used on doors located near windows. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is key operated from both the interior and the exterior while the latch underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob/lever from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Also available matching:
Mansion Single Cylinder Handleset
Mansion Dummy Handleset

This traditional handleset is from the Weslock Elegance Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Weslock Double Cylinder Mansion Entrance Set:

  • Material: solid brass
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • Adjustable latches with removable faceplates.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with 2-1/8" (1-5/8" optional) top and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Elegance Collection Arched Mansion Double Cylinder Handleset:

  • Exterior Length: 18-1/2"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 3"
  • Interior Length: 10-1/8"
  • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
